entries.speaker: Shadow
entries.en: Welcome to the Battle Arena, the[n]infernal fighting ground where[n]the embers of life glow bright.

entries.speaker: Shadow
entries.en: Oh, it's you guys... Our manager[n]told us about you.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh? The hell've you been[n]hearin' about us!?

entries.speaker: Shadow
entries.en: My, you're so quick to anger.[n]Wonderful. This would be quite[n]boring if that wasn't the case.

entries.speaker: Shadow
entries.en: Now, allow me to confirm something[n]before I begin explaining... Do you[n]currently have [clr 2]10,000[clr 27] coins?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uhhh, what? We don't.

entries.speaker: Shadow
entries.en: Well that won't do at all. This is[n]out of the question if you don't[n]have enough for the entry fee.

entries.speaker: Shadow
entries.en: Now listen up: Come back here[n]once you have that amount.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Hm, it seems the games on this floor[n]all require participation fees...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Hm, it seems this game requires[n]a participation fee...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh well. We need to play by the[n]rules, so let's go find somewhere[n]we can win the necessary coins.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Oh! Yes, we do!

entries.speaker: Shadow
entries.en: Oh, you have surely been busy.[n]Very well then, allow me to[n]explain this game to you.

entries.speaker: Shadow
entries.en: Here, you will prove your supremacy[n]in a trio of fierce one-on-one battles.

entries.speaker: Shadow
entries.en: Then again... this is the pinnacle[n]of our casino, the high limit floor.

entries.speaker: Shadow
entries.en: Normally, our VIPs would prepare[n]substitutes who fight to the[n]death for their sake...

entries.speaker: Shadow
entries.en: The attending guests then bet coins[n]on who they think will win.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Here too...? Ugh, this shit makes me sick.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: The entirety of this floor must be like that.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Taking little risk for a high return is[n]truly the optimal business strategy.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But can we even participate if we[n]don't have a substitute...?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, we didn't need one[n]for the other game!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The same probably applies in here too.

entries.speaker: Shadow
entries.en: As irritating as it may be, that is correct.[n]Please participate.

entries.speaker: Shadow
entries.en: Registration will take place[n]at the counter over there.
